title: AbRank: Antibody Affinity Ranking
subtitle: Zero-Leakage 3-State Antibody–Antigen & Nanobody Affinity Ranking Benchmark (v2)
description:
# AbRank v2: Sequence- and Lineage-Disjoint 3-State Antibody–Antigen Affinity Ranking Benchmark

> **Version Notice — AbRank v2 replaces AbRank v1 as the default release.**
> The original **AbRank v1** release (`AbRank_dataset.csv` and `AbRank_structures/`) remains permanently preserved and accessible via the Kaggle **Version** selector (`Versions 1–4`, latest v1 = `Version 4`) or programmatically via `kagglehub.dataset_download("aurlienplissier/abrank/versions/4")`.
>
> **What changed from v1 → v2?**
> - **Expanded & Newly Public Data (`9 → 24` sources):** Adds 15 new experimental datasets — including the now-public `CC BY 4.0` **AIntibody**, **Origin-1**, **Germinal**, **BoltzGen**, **Abbate-GFRAL**, **FLAb (Kothiwal & Shanker)**, **MAGMA-seq (Kirby & Peterson)**, **AbBiBench**, **AbAgym** (45-complex DMS), and **NbBench** — expanding to `192` antigen groups, single-domain **VHH nanobodies**, and `1,354` wet-lab generative AI designs.
> - **3-State Noise-Buffered Evaluation (`{-1, 0, +1}`):** Upgrades v1's binary `10×` ranking to empirically calibrated 3-state evaluation with a replicate-noise neutral band (`|ΔpKd| ≤ 0.30`, `≤2×`), jointly scoring Directional Sign, Hot-Spot Impact, and 3-Class Ordinal AUC alongside unfiltered continuous panels (`*_pointwise.tsv`).
> - **Strict Zero-Leakage Splits & 4 Core Community Suites:** Replaces v1's single table with pre-clustered `<50%` antigen-identity and `<80%` clonal-lineage disjoint splits across `AbRank-Maturation`, `AbRank-Discovery`, `AbRank-Generative`, and `AbRank-Transfer`.
> - **851 Wild-Type 3D Scaffolds & Standardized Hygiene:** Replaces v1's antigen-only structures with `340` experimental RCSB PDB co-crystals + `511` unbound IgFold Fv/VHH scaffolds (`structures_wt/`), strict 20-AA Fab-to-Fv / tag trimming, and MLCommons Croissant 1.0 metadata (`metadata/croissant.json`).

---

## Links & Companion Resources

- **Official Code, Curation Pipeline & Evaluator**: [github.com/AI-SysBio/AbRank](https://github.com/AI-SysBio/AbRank)
- **Companion Co-Folded 3D Dataset (`34,040` AF3, Boltz-2, Chai-1 & Protenix Poses, `3.1 GB`)**: [kaggle.com/datasets/aurlienplissier/abrank-cofolded-3d](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/aurlienplissier/abrank-cofolded-3d)
- **Companion `AbLang2-Paired + ESM-2` LogiCA Implementation**: [github.com/AI-SysBio/LogiCA/tree/main/applications/antibodies-abrank](https://github.com/AI-SysBio/LogiCA/tree/main/applications/antibodies-abrank)
- **Starter Kaggle Notebook**: [AbRank v2 Quickstart and 3-State Evaluation](https://www.kaggle.com/code/aurlienplissier/abrank-v2-quickstart-and-3-state-evaluation)

---

## Dataset Overview

All assay tables enforce strict 20-standard-amino-acid variable-region hygiene (`VH`, `VL`, or `VHH` + assayed antigen ectodomain) and a unified sign convention (**higher `binding_score` always means stronger binding**, e.g., `pKd = 9 - log10(Kd [nM])`):

- **`120,721`** deduplicated paired-chain `KD` assays (`111,743` unique antibodies across `262` clonal lineages, `148` antigen groups)
- **`192`** cataloged antigen groups (`161` non-viral, `31` viral) spanning `KD`, `Enrichment`, `ELISA`, `DDG`, `EC50`, `AbAgym DMS`, viral `IC50`, `RBD Escape`, and single-domain **`VHH` nanobodies**
- **`851`** wild-type parental 3D scaffolds (`340` solved RCSB PDB co-crystals + `511` unbound IgFold Fv/VHH + RCSB antigen scaffolds) + `68` AbAgym complex PDBs

### 3-State Noise-Buffered Labels (`{-1, 0, +1}`)
Within-assay pairs are labeled across three states calibrated against empirical replicate noise (`95.2%` of within-platform SPR replicates fall within `|ΔpKd| ≤ 0.30`):
- **`+1` (Improved):** `Δbinding_score ≥ +1.0` (`≥10×` tighter `Kd`)
- **`0` (Neutral):** `|Δbinding_score| ≤ 0.30` (`≤2×` `Kd` change)
- **`-1` (Depleted):** `Δbinding_score ≤ -1.0` (`≥10×` weaker `Kd`)

### The 4 Core AbRank Community Suites

| Suite (`--suite`) | Scope (`<50%` Ag, `<80%` Ab) | Headline Metrics |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`AbRank-Maturation`** (`maturation`) | 22-Cluster LOACO Local Edits (`12,267` `L1–L3` `Kd` pairs; `5,426` impactful `±1`) | Cluster-Macro **3-Class Ordinal AUC**, Sign AUC, Impact AUC |
| **`AbRank-Discovery`** (`discovery`) | 25 Unfiltered LOACO Library Panels (`6–200` clones) + `VHH` `Kd` (`11` targets) | Panel-Macro **Top-Binder AUC**, **Precision@Top-20%**, `VHH` Ord AUC |
| **`AbRank-Generative`** (`generative`) | `1,354` Wet-Lab Generative AI Designs (`20` panels, `5,069` pairs: `IgDesign`, `Origin1`, `BoltzGen_VHH`, `Germinal`, `AIntibody`, `Shanker`) | **Generative Ordinal AUC**, **Precision@Top-20%**, **Top-20% Regret** |
| **`AbRank-Transfer`** (`transfer`) | Biochemical → Functional Adaptation (`Viral IC50`, `RBD Escape`, `AbAgym DMS`, `ELISA`, `DDG`) | Per-Antigen Macro **3-Class Ordinal AUC** & **Sign AUC** |

---

## Directory Layout

- **Root Benchmark Tables & Splits** (`801 MB` uncompressed):
  - `assays_kd.tsv`, `assays_vhh.tsv`, `assays_cross_modal.tsv`, `assays_transfer.tsv` — Master deduplicated pointwise assay tables
  - `splits/unseen_ag/` — Zero-leakage `train/val/test` 3-state pairs, `*_candidates.tsv`, and unfiltered `*_pointwise.tsv` panels
  - `splits/generative/` — `generative_pairs.tsv` & `generative_panels.tsv`
  - `splits/transfer/` — `ic50_test.tsv` & `escape_test.tsv`
  - `splits/cross_modal/modality_test.tsv` & `splits/vhh/vhh_ranking_test.tsv`
  - `sequences/` — Deduplicated FASTA files (`ab_heavy.fasta`, `ab_light.fasta`, `ag.fasta`, `vhh.fasta`, `vhh_ag.fasta`)
  - `BENCHMARK_SUMMARY.md` & `benchmark_summary.json`
- **`metadata/`** (`0.6 MB`):
  - `croissant.json` (MLCommons Croissant 1.0 + RAI), `sources_manifest.yaml` (citations, DOIs & licenses for all 24 sources), `cofolding_manifest.tsv` (851 WT scaffolds), `antigen_catalog.tsv`, `pdb_mapping.tsv`, `structure_templates.yaml`, `constructs/`
- **`structures_wt/`** (`394 MB`, `1,823` files):
  - Wild-type 3D scaffolds for Track 1B WT-3D baselines: `rcsb/` (`356` PDB/mmCIF archives), `igfold/` (`548` unbound Fv/VHH models), `scaffolds/` (`851` standardized WT complex PDBs), `abagym_pdbs/` (`68` AbAgym PDBs)

## Quickstart

### 1. Load Directly in Python (`kagglehub`)
```python
import kagglehub
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(kagglehub.dataset_download("aurlienplissier/abrank"))
assays_kd = pd.read_csv(root / "assays_kd.tsv", sep="\t")
test_pairs = pd.read_csv(root / "splits/unseen_ag/test.tsv", sep="\t")

# Need legacy AbRank v1? Pin version 1 explicitly:
# v1_root = Path(kagglehub.dataset_download("aurlienplissier/abrank/versions/4"))
```

### 2. Evaluate Predictions in One Command (`AI-SysBio/AbRank`)
```bash
pip install "git+https://github.com/AI-SysBio/AbRank.git" kagglehub

# Accepts pairwise (pair_id, pred_diff[, pred_impact]) or pointwise (AbAgID, pred_score) TSVs:
python -m abrank.evaluate --suite maturation --kaggle-dataset aurlienplissier/abrank --preds my_preds.tsv
python -m abrank.evaluate --suite discovery  --kaggle-dataset aurlienplissier/abrank --preds my_pointwise.tsv
python -m abrank.evaluate --suite generative --kaggle-dataset aurlienplissier/abrank --preds my_gen_preds.tsv
python -m abrank.evaluate --suite transfer   --kaggle-dataset aurlienplissier/abrank --preds my_transfer.tsv
```

### 3. Train & Evaluate `AbLang2-Paired + ESM-2` LogiCA (`AI-SysBio/LogiCA`)
```bash
git clone https://github.com/AI-SysBio/LogiCA.git && cd LogiCA
pip install -e ".[all]"
python applications/antibodies-abrank/scripts/02_train_ablang_esm_logica.py --kaggle-dataset aurlienplissier/abrank
python applications/antibodies-abrank/scripts/03_evaluate_on_abrank.py --suite maturation --kaggle-dataset aurlienplissier/abrank
```

---

## Provenance & Licenses
AbRank v2 aggregates 24 publicly released peer-reviewed antibody and nanobody datasets (including the 2026 `CC BY 4.0` AIntibody, Germinal, Abbate-GFRAL, Origin-1, and BoltzGen releases). Full citations, DOIs, and per-source licenses are documented in `metadata/sources_manifest.yaml` and `metadata/croissant.json`. Each constituent dataset retains its upstream license.

fields.description: Concatenated variable antibody sequence (VH|VL for paired antibodies; VHH for single-domain nanobodies).

fields.name: AgID
fields.description: Canonical unique antigen sequence identifier across the benchmark.

fields.name: AbAgID
fields.description: Canonical unique antibody-antigen complex identifier linking pointwise tables, pairwise splits, and 3D scaffolds.

fields.name: AbAg_seq
fields.description: Full concatenated antibody and antigen sequence key used for exact deduplication.

fields.name: Ab_lineage
fields.description: Connected-component antibody clonal lineage cluster ID (>=80% paired Fv or VHH sequence identity).

fields.name: Ag_cluster
fields.description: Connected-component homologous antigen cluster ID (>=50% global identity or >=25 AA shared subdomain).

resources.description: Single-domain VHH nanobody 3-state KD ranking test pairs (813 pairs across 19 antigen groups).

fields.name: pair_id
fields.description: Unique deterministic identifier for the ordered comparison (AbAgID_1, AbAgID_2).

fields.name: AbAgID_1
fields.description: Complex identifier of the first antibody-antigen variant in the pair (maps to AbAgID in assays_*.tsv).

fields.name: AbAgID_2
fields.description: Complex identifier of the second antibody-antigen variant in the pair (maps to AbAgID in assays_*.tsv).

fields.name: binding_diff
fields.description: Signed difference binding_score(1) - binding_score(2); positive values mean variant 1 binds more strongly.

fields.name: logKD_diff
fields.description: Negated binding difference (-binding_diff), corresponding to log10(Kd_1 / Kd_2) on KD tracks.

fields.name: label
fields.description: 3-state noise-buffered ground-truth label: +1 (Improved, >=10x tighter), 0 (Neutral, <=2x replicate noise band), -1 (Depleted, >=10x weaker).

fields.name: Category
fields.description: Mutational edit regime: L1/L2/L3 (1-3 AA edits), Candidate (same antigen, Lev > 3), or Global (cross-antigen).

fields.name: Lev_distance
fields.description: Combined Levenshtein edit distance between variant 1 and variant 2 sequences.

fields.name: AbRank_group
fields.description: Evaluation stratum identifier used for balanced 50/50 sampling and macro-averaged scoring.

fields.name: Ag_group_1
fields.description: Canonical antigen group of AbAgID_1.

fields.name: Ag_group_2
fields.description: Canonical antigen group of AbAgID_2.

fields.name: Ag_type
fields.description: High-level target category: Viral or Non-Viral.

fields.name: Assay_modality
fields.description: Experimental binding assay type (KD, Enrichment, ELISA, DDG, EC50, DMS, IC50, or Escape).

fields.name: Dataset_1
fields.description: Source dataset of AbAgID_1.

fields.name: Dataset_2
fields.description: Source dataset of AbAgID_2.

fields.name: Antigen_name
fields.description: Canonical reference antigen name.

fields.name: Ag_type
fields.description: High-level target category: Viral or Non-Viral.

fields.name: Ag_seq
fields.description: Standardized 20-AA assayed antigen ectodomain amino acid sequence with recombinant purification tags removed.

resources.description: Manifest of all 851 wild-type parental antibody/VHH-antigen scaffolds (340 solved co-crystals + 511 unresolved) with priority tiers and exact sequences.

fields.name: scaffold_id
fields.description: Unique wild-type parental 3D scaffold identifier matching structures_wt/scaffolds/<scaffold_id>.pdb.

fields.name: priority_tier
fields.description: Co-folding evaluation priority tier (1_loaco_local, 2_candidate_and_vhh, or 3_cross_modal_and_global).

fields.name: tracks
fields.description: Comma-separated AbRank tracks covered by this wild-type parental scaffold.

fields.name: is_experimental_cocrystal
fields.description: True if an experimentally solved RCSB PDB antibody-antigen co-crystal exists for this WT scaffold.

fields.name: wt_pdb_id
fields.description: Experimental RCSB PDB ID for solved WT co-crystals (empty if unbound/predicted).

fields.name: ref_scaffold_pdb
fields.description: Relative path to the standardized wild-type scaffold PDB file.

fields.name: n_chains
fields.description: Number of protein chains in the scaffold (3 for VH+VL+Ag; 2 for VHH+Ag).

fields.name: total_aa_len
fields.description: Total amino acid length across all chains in the WT complex.

fields.name: len_H
fields.description: Length of the heavy chain (VH or VHH) in amino acids.

fields.name: len_L
fields.description: Length of the light chain (VL) in amino acids (0 for VHH nanobodies).

fields.name: len_A
fields.description: Length of the antigen chain in amino acids.

fields.name: seq_H
fields.description: Wild-type heavy chain (VH or VHH) amino acid sequence.

fields.name: seq_L
fields.description: Wild-type light chain (VL) amino acid sequence (empty for VHH nanobodies).

fields.name: seq_A
fields.description: Wild-type antigen ectodomain amino acid sequence.
